title: Jubilees 8 — The table of nations and the division of the earth by lot

translation.sourceText: Jubilees — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction. Ge'ez primary (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511); Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus 21-24, ed. Dean 1935) preserves substantial portions of the Shem/Ham/Japheth land-allotments at 8:12, 22, 25. 11Q12 not preserved at this chapter.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፳ ወ፱ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ነሥአ፡ አርፋክስድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ራሱኤያ፡ ወለተ፡ ሱሰን፡ ወለተ፡ ኤላም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በ፫ ዓመት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኬናን፡

i18n.en: And in the twenty-ninth jubilee, in the first week, in the beginning of it, Arpachshad took to himself a wife whose name was Rasueya, the daughter of Susan, the daughter of Elam, as a wife; and she bore him a son in the third year of this week, and he called his name Kenan.

paragraphs.translit: waba20 wa9 ʾiyobēlwu qadāmāwi sabuʿ qadāmi naśʾa ʾarfāksəd lotu bəʾsita səmā rāsuʾēyā walata susan walata ʾēlām bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda ba3 ʿāmat bazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo kēnān

paragraphs.text: ወልሕቀ፡ ወልድ፡ ወመሐሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወሖረ፡ ከመ፡ የኀሥሥ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካነ፡ ኀበ፡ ይምስት፡ ቤተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወረከበ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ጥቅት፡ በውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወአንበበ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወገለበቦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ቦቱ፡

i18n.en: And the son grew, and his father taught him writing; and he went out to seek for himself a place where he might take a city for himself. And he found an inscription which the ancients had engraved upon a rock; and he read what was written in it, and he copied it, and he sinned because of it.

paragraphs.translit: waləḥqa waləd wamaḥaro ʾabuhu ṣəḥfata waḥora kama yaḫaśəś lotu makāna ḫaba yəmsət bēta lotu warakaba ṣəḥfata ṭəqət bawəsta kʷakʷəḥ waʾanbaba zaṣḥuf botu wagalababo waʾabasa botu

paragraphs.text: ወአበሰ፡ እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ኪነ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ በውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትእምርት፡ ለሰማይ፡

i18n.en: For it contained the teaching of the Watchers, by which they used to observe the omens of the sun and the moon and the stars in all the signs of heaven.

paragraphs.translit: waʾabasa ʾəsma botu śərʿata təguhān zabotu kina ḍaḥay wawarəḫ wakawākbət bawəsta kʷəlu təʾəmrət lasamāy

paragraphs.text: ወጸሐፎ፡ ወኢዘንተ፡ ለመኑሂ፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ይብል፡ ለኖኅ፡ ለእመ፡ ይትመዐዕ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡

i18n.en: And he wrote it down, and said nothing of it to anyone; for he was afraid to speak to Noah about it, lest he be angry with him on account of it.

paragraphs.translit: waṣaḥafo waʾizanta lamanuhi ʾəsma yəfarəh yəbəl lanoḫ laʾma yətmaʿaʿ lāʿlēhu baʾəntiʾahu

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ መልካ፡ ወለተ፡ ምሉሐድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሳላ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ በአማን፡ ተፈነውኩ፡

i18n.en: And in the thirtieth jubilee, in the fourth week, in the first year of it, he took to himself a wife whose name was Melka, the daughter of Madai, as a wife; and she bore him a son in the fourth year of this week, and he called his name Shelah, for he said: Truly I have been sent.

paragraphs.translit: waba30 ʾiyobēlwu barābəʿ sabuʿ baqadāmāwi ʿāmat naśʾa lotu bəʾsita səmā malkā walata məluḥad bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda barābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo sālā ʾəsma yəbē baʾamān tafanawku

paragraphs.text: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሳላ፡ ሄበር፡ በ፴ ወ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡

i18n.en: And Shelah begot Eber in the thirty-second jubilee, in the sixth week, in the first year of this week.

paragraphs.translit: wawalada lotu sālā hēbar ba30 wa2 ʾiyobēlwu basādəs sabuʿ baʿāmat qadāmāwi lazəntu sabuʿ

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ አዙራድ፡ ወለተ፡ ኔብሮድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ፋሌቅ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሎቱ፡ ተፈለጡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ምድረ፡

i18n.en: And he took to himself a wife whose name was Azurad, the daughter of Nimrod, as a wife; and she bore him a son in the fourth year of this week, and he called his name Peleg — for in his days the sons of Noah divided the earth among themselves.

paragraphs.translit: wanaśʾa lotu bəʾsita səmā ʾazurād walata nēbrod bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda barābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo fālēq ʾəsma bamawāʿla lotu tafalaṭu daqiqa noḫ mədra

paragraphs.text: ወጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወከፈሎሙ፡ ምድረ፡ በዕፃ፡ በ፴ ወ፫ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡

i18n.en: And Noah called his sons, and he divided the earth among them by lot, in the thirty-third jubilee, in the first week, in the first year of it.

paragraphs.translit: waṣawʿa noḫ ladaqiqu wakafalomu mədra baʿḍā ba30 wa3 ʾiyobēlwu baqadāmāwi sabuʿ baʿāmat qadāmāwi

paragraphs.text: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለሴም፡ ቀዳሚ፡ መዐርግ፡ ዘበማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ማእከለ፡ መነጸፍ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ መታክፍት፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ ኤድኒ፡ ምስራቅ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ወውስተ፡ ግዱፍ፡ ምድር፡ ምስራቅ፡ ኮነ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ኮነ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ቅዱስ፡

i18n.en: And the lot of Shem came forth first, for the middle portion of the earth, which he should take as an inheritance for himself and for his sons for the generations of eternity — from the middle of the mountain-region, the portion at the center, toward the east unto Eden; this was a holy portion and the first to come forth.

paragraphs.translit: wawaḍʾa ʿəḍu lasēm qadāmi maʿarəg zabamāʾkala mədər māʾkala manaṣaf larʾəska kidana matākfət larʾəska kidana ʾēdni məsrāq safarka wawəsta gəduf mədər məsrāq kona qadāmi kona safarka qədus

paragraphs.text: ወከደነ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይትገበር፡ እግዚእ፡ መካነ፡ ለሴም፡ ለክብር፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: And Noah covered himself, and blessed Shem, and said: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Shem; and may the Lord make a place for Shem of glory in the middle of the earth.

paragraphs.translit: wakadana noḫ wabārako lasēm waybē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka sēm wayətgabar ʾəgziʾ makāna lasēm lakbər māʾkala mədər

paragraphs.text: ወወፅአ፡ ጽሕፈት፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኀበ፡ ሴም፡ ወወዘናሁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኀደገ፡ ለሴም፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስከ፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ኤዶም፡

i18n.en: And a writing went forth from Noah to Shem; and Noah by it bequeathed to Shem and to his sons for the generations of eternity all the land from the land of Eden as far as the land — the land of Eden.

paragraphs.translit: wawaḍʾa ṣəḥfat ḫaba noḫ ḫaba sēm wawazanāhu lanoḫ botu ḫadaga lasēm waladaqiqu latwəldomu laʿālam kʷəlo mədər ʾəmna mədra ʾēdom ʾəska mədər mədər mədər ʾēdom

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Σήμ μεσογαίᾳ τῆς γῆς ἣν λαμβάνει εἰς κληρονομίαν αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος, ἀπὸ τοῦ μέσου τοῦ ὄρους Ῥάφα, ἀπὸ ἐξόδου τοῦ Τίνα ποταμοῦ· καὶ προέρχεται ὁ κλῆρος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ δυσμὰς διὰ μέσου τοῦ ποταμοῦ τούτου, καὶ προέρχεται ἕως ὅτου ἀφικνεῖται εἰς τὴν Ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν.

i18n.en: And the lot came forth for Shem in the middle of the earth, which he was to take as an inheritance for himself and for his sons for the generations of eternity — from the middle of Mount Rapha, from the outflow of the river Tina; and his lot proceeds westward through the middle of this river, and proceeds until it arrives at the Erythraean Sea, and proceeds along the land beside this sea as far as the land of Egypt — the great sea — and proceeds toward the land of Lebanon and the land of Sennaar, and to the territory of Eden.

paragraphs.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Sēm mesogaia tēs gēs hēn lambanei eis klēronomian autō kai tois teknois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos, apo tou mesou tou orous Rhapha, apo exodou tou Tina potamou· kai proerchetai ho klēros autou epi dysmas dia mesou tou potamou toutou, kai proerchetai heōs hotou aphikneitai eis tēn Erythran thalassan.

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለሴም፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ፀሐይ፡

i18n.en: And for Shem it proceeds toward the north, and it proceeds toward the east, and through the middle of the east, and through the middle of Egypt, and it proceeds along the east of the Erythraean Sea until it arrives at the place where the sun rises.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu lasēm mangala samēn waykayəd mangala məśrāq wamāʾkala məśrāq wamāʾkala gəbəṣ waykayəd mangala məśrāq ʾērətrā bāḥər ʾəska yəkayəd ḫaba yəwaḍəʾ ḍaḥay

paragraphs.text: ወሴም፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ይሐርሁ፡ ቦቱ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ ዘምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡

i18n.en: And Shem and his sons shall till for themselves all the land of the east, all of it.

paragraphs.translit: wasēm wawludu yəḥarhu botu larəʾsomu kʷəlo mədər zaməśrāq kʷəlu

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካን፡ ሠናይ፡ ወክቡር፡ ወኵሉ፡ መካን፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ምድር፡ ሠናይ፡ ወቡሩክ፡

i18n.en: And there came to him a good place and glorious — and every place that proceeds toward the east is a good and blessed land.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu makān śanāy wakbur wakʷlu makān zaykayəd mangala məśrāq mədər śanāy waburuk

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤላም፡ ወአሱር፡ ወባቤል፡ ወሱስ፡ ወማሕር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘያቆስ፡ መንገለ፡ ቤትባቤል፡

i18n.en: And there came to him all the land of Elam and Asshur and Babel and Susa and Media, and every land that lies toward the region of Babel.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu kʷəlu mədra ʾēlām waʾasur wabābēl wasus wamāḥər wakʷlu mədər zayāqos mangala bētbābēl

paragraphs.text: ወባረኮ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይዕቀብ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካኖ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ እምነ፡ መካን፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘፈጠረ፡ ሎቱ፡

i18n.en: And Noah blessed Shem, and said: Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and may he keep for him his place — for him and for his sons for the generations of eternity — out of the holy place which he has fashioned for him.

paragraphs.translit: wabārako noḫ lasēm waybē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka sēm wayəʿqab lotu makāno lotu waladaqiqu latwəldomu laʿālam ʾəmna makān qədus zafaṭara lotu

paragraphs.text: ወአእመረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ መካን፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወመክፈልት፡ ቡሩክ፡ ወድቀ፡ ለሴም፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሕንድ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ዘይከይድ፡

i18n.en: And Noah knew that a blessed place and a blessed lot had fallen to Shem and to his sons for the generations of eternity — all the land of Eden in the east, and all the land of the east, and toward India, and along the Erythraean Sea which it borders.

paragraphs.translit: waʾaʾmara noḫ kama makān buruk wamakfalət buruk wadqa lasēm waladaqiqu latwəldomu laʿālam kʷəlu mədra ʾēdom wəsta məśrāq wakʷlu mədər məśrāq wamangala ḥənəd wawəsta ʾērətrā zaykayəd

paragraphs.text: ወአእመረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ቅድስት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወምኅደረ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወደብረ፡ ሲና፡ ማእከለ፡ ገዳም፡ ወደብረ፡ ጽዮን፡ ማእከለ፡ ሕንባል፡ ምድር፡ ፫ እማንቱ፡ ቅድስት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ቅሩብ፡ አሐዱ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡

i18n.en: And Noah knew that the Garden of Eden is the holy of holies, and the dwelling of the Lord; and Mount Sinai — in the midst of the desert; and Mount Zion — in the midst of the navel of the earth; these three were created as holy of holies, the one facing the other.

notes.official: THE EXPLICIT OMPHALOS formulation: Mount Zion as the navel of the earth + Mount Sinai as center of the desert + Mount of the East / Eden-mountain as center of the world. The three-holy-mountains formula extending the Jerusalem-omphalos tradition.

paragraphs.translit: waʾaʾmara noḫ kama ganata ʾēdom qədsət qədusāt yəʾti waməḫdara ʾəgziʾ wadabra sinā māʾkala gadām wadabra ṣəyon māʾkala ḥənbāl mədər 3 ʾəmāntu qədsət qədusāt qərub ʾaḥadu məsla kālʾu

paragraphs.text: ወባረኮ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ለሊቀ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ እስመ፡ ፈለጠ፡ መካናተ፡ ቅዱሳተ፡ ለርእሱ፡

i18n.en: And he blessed the God of heaven, the Most High of his covenant, because he had set apart the holy places for himself.

paragraphs.translit: wabārako laʾamlāka samāy laliqa kidānu ʾəsma falaṭa makānāta qədusāta larəʾsu

paragraphs.text: ወባረከ፡ ቡሩክ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይሥራዕ፡ እግዚእ፡ መካናተ፡ ቅዱሳተ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይነብር፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡

i18n.en: And he blessed the Lord God of Shem, that the Lord might appoint the holy places for Shem, and that he might dwell there forever.

paragraphs.translit: wabāraka buruk laʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka sēm wayəśrāʿ ʾəgziʾ makānāta qədusāta lasēm waynabər ʾəska laʿālam

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Χάμ ὥστε γενέσθαι αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος μερὶς πρὸς μεσημβρίαν, ἀπὸ τοῦ Γηῶν ποταμοῦ ἕως ἀνατολῶν.

i18n.en: And the lot came forth for Ham, that it should be his and his sons' for the generations of eternity — a portion toward the south, from the river Gihon as far as the east, and proceeds toward the south, all the land toward the south of the Kedero region; and his lot proceeds round all this land of Ham.

paragraphs.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Cham hōste genesthai autō kai tois hyiois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos meris pros mesēmbrian, apo tou Gēōn potamou heōs anatolōn.

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ኬዶሮ፡ ምድር፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለፈለግ፡ ጊዮን፡ ወይከይድ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ እምነ፡ ጊዮን፡ ፈለግ፡

i18n.en: And there came to him all the land of Kedero, the land that lies beside the river Gihon; and there came to him all the land that is toward the west, from the river Gihon.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu kʷəlu mədər kēdoro mədər zaykayəd qəruba lafalag giyon waykayəd lalotu kʷəlu mədər zamangala məʿrāb ʾəmna giyon falag

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ መንገለ፡ የማን፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፡ አፉና፡ ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ምስለ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘውስቴታ፡

i18n.en: And it proceeds toward the south, and it proceeds toward the west, toward the sea Afuna; and the land toward the west came to him, together with the Erythraean Sea that is within it.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu mangala yamān waykayəd mangala məʿrāb mangala bāḥər ʾafunā waykayəd lotu mədər mangala məʿrāb məsla ʾērətrā bāḥər zawəstētā

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Ἰάφεθ ὥστε γενέσθαι αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος μερὶς πρὸς ἄρκτον ἐπὶ δυσμάς, βορρᾶν τοῦ Τίνα ποταμοῦ.

i18n.en: And the lot came forth for Japheth, that it should be his and his sons' for the generations of eternity — a portion toward the north, toward the west, north of the river Tina; and it proceeds toward the north, toward the west, toward Magog and all that is north of the river Tina.

paragraphs.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Iapheth hōste genesthai autō kai tois hyiois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos meris pros arkton epi dysmas, borran tou Tina potamou.

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ዘመዓዶ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ይውድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ጲንቶስ፡ ባሕር፡

i18n.en: And there came to him all the land toward the west, on the far side of the river Tina, which proceeds and falls into the Pontus Sea.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu kʷəlu mədər mangala məʿrāb zamaʿādo latinā falag zaykayəd yəwdəq wəsta p̣intos bāḥər

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ቤትፋራም፡ ወፋርሰ፡ ድልዕ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለፈለግ፡ ቲና፡ ወይከይድ፡ ለማእከለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ብሔር፡ ወያእለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ይከይድ፡

i18n.en: And it proceeds toward the west, toward Beth-Faram and the borderland of Pars, and it proceeds beside the river Tina; and it proceeds through the middle of the western land, and it proceeds toward the north.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd mangala məʿrāb mangala bētfārām wafārsa dələʿ waykayəd qəruba lafalag tinā waykayəd lamāʾkala məʿrāb bəḥēr wayāʾla samēn yəkayəd

paragraphs.text: ወያእለ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ይከይድ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ መካን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡

i18n.en: And it proceeds toward the west, in all its course, until it arrives at the place in the west where the Erythraean Sea reaches.

paragraphs.translit: wayāʾla kʷəlo mangala məʿrāb yəkayəd ʾəska yəkayəd ḫaba makān mangala məʿrāb ḫaba yəkayəd ʾērətrā bāḥər

paragraphs.text: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወሐ፬፡ ደሰያት፡ ዐበይተ፡

i18n.en: And there came to him all the western land and the northern land, all the land toward the north, and four great islands.

paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu kʷəlo mangala məʿrāb wamangala samēn kʷəlo mədər mangala samēn waḥa4 dasayāt ʿabayta

paragraphs.text: ወባሕቱ፡ ቅርሕም፡ መካኑ፡ ወቍርና፡ ለመክፈልቱ፡ ዘያፌት፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡ መካን፡ ምውቅ፡ ወምድር፡ ዘሴም፡ ሞቃር፡ ወዘያፌት፡ ቍሩር፡

i18n.en: But the place of Japheth is hot and cold, while the land of Ham is a hot place; and the land of Shem is temperate, but the land of Japheth is cold.

paragraphs.translit: wabāḥtu qərḥəm makānu waqʷərnā lamakfaltu zayāfēt ʾəmna mədər zaḥam makān məwəq wamdər zasēm moqār wazayāfēt qʷərur
